card.name: Word endings after a split stem
card.fires_on: The ending piece of a word that was split into parts, such as 'ans' in Slogans, 'its' in Affidavits, or ' se' after 'per'. It appears in ordinary web text and legal or medical text.

modes.label: Plural or ending pieces
modes.description: The last piece of a longer noun after its stem, often a plural ending.
modes.example: Accounting, Affidav<<its>>, Assignments, Attorney Forms & Guides

modes.label: Per se
modes.description: The word 'se' or 'say' right after 'per' in the phrase 'per se'.
modes.example: by itself" and should be spelled "per<< se>>".

card.writes: It promotes short word-start pieces like ' re', ' test', ' p' and ' path', which suggests it pushes the next word to begin with a new short piece.
card.plain: It fires on the closing piece of a word that was broken into parts, such as the end of 'affidavits' or 'per se'.
